issue_design: At the end of C00 for k_tile=R-2, call the existing global load_sfa_panel(R) into the already-consumed raw array.
Load SFB into a distinct pending raw word using the existing wave/lane guards. Do not publish either panel to LDS at the early issue point.
Track pending panel begin/valid state; at refill(R), use its raw values. Keep the lgkmcnt(0)+barrier before overwrite, vmcnt(0) before publish, and lgkmcnt(0)+barrier after publication.
Retain a boundary-only fallback for an unissued panel and the same tail refill. Never issue R==loops. Do not change the matrix-prefetch sequence or wait counter thresholds.
resource_risks: Longer raw scale liveness can raise VGPR/SGPR pressure and create spills; P32 needs 8 raw SFA dwords per lane and P64 16, plus pending SFB/state.
Early loads compete with matrix VM requests. Their earlier issue may help, have no effect, or worsen latency.
For K4096/P32 and K7168/P64 there is no refill; added runtime bookkeeping can only be a control cost, not a scale-refill benefit.
safety_invariants: Old panel stays in LDS through all old-scale reads; first prefetch only touches raw registers.
The exact original two refill barriers and both wait families remain.
Preserve raw E8M0 byte order, K128-to-four-K32 broadcast, partial-M/lane masks, K loop count, all MFMA and FP32 accumulation ordering.
Preserve C AGPR pin ranges, BF16 output conversion, output LDS reuse and tile-bounded buffer addressing.
variants.decision_rule: Proceed only after CPU lifetime/edge-case model and future isolated metadata/ISA review; then compare each new instance to its exact base on a shared fixed rotation and matched measurement setting. No claimed expected speedup.

variants.design: Compare matched legacy gm0/gm4/gm8 images at exactly the same P64/pad=false/wide/unroll2 configuration. GroupM only changes mapping, not grid cardinality.
variants.warning: Current registry/build metadata only expose GroupM0. Archive images have SGPR68 versus current389 SGPR104. Equal MFMA/wait counts do not prove identical source generation. Do not compare old gm4 directly to current389 as a single-factor result.
prerequisites: Prove matching 96-byte kernarg ABI, loader address and LDS/resource limits, receipt/image identity and exact launch symbols in an isolated package.
Enumerate GroupM mapping for partial final groups; no duplicate or missing logical output tile.
No new launch ID is assigned by this plan. Do not add these images to the current source/SO or the 14-case frozen bundle.

variants.design: If the fixed-geometry prefetch experiment has no stable gain, separately redesign matrix LDS to one K128 slot. This requires a new staged publication and operand-lifetime proof; it is not a wait-counter tweak.
variants.limitation: 76032 is below80KiB, so LDS alone would permit two allocations in160KiB. Existing register/pin limits may still prevent two resident workgroups; no occupancy improvement is promised.
variants.alternative: A smaller BM is a separate structural proposal. BM128 with existing two slots is approximately110080 bytes at P64, still above80KiB; its value would be smaller accumulator footprint and more grid tiles, not automatic LDS residency.
variants.prerequisite: Separate design and isolated compilation authorization after the first bounded experiment; do not combine this with scale prefetch in the initial variants.

static_findings: All12 basic4wave CO configurations are currently registered/ready; existing representative geometry is present.
P16/P32/P64 LDS139392/143616/152064 all exceed81920, so changing the scale panel alone cannot permit2WG/CU from LDS capacity.
Padded P32/P64 CO metadata report3/4 SGPR spills and zero private segment; ISA P32 shows3 v_writelane/3 v_readlane. This is not evidence of HBM scratch traffic or a measured stall bottleneck.
Modern389 ELF metadata and build_info agree: VGPR456, SGPR104, AGPR212, LDS152064, no spills/private segment.
Modern389 static ISA has320 scaled MFMA,68 waitcnt,16 barrier instructions; these are static text counts including prologue/tail/unrolling, not dynamic counts or stall cycles.
limits_of_evidence: No device timings were generated. CSV uses mixed retained101/5 and quick11/2 settings and establishes gaps, not hardware causes.
Resource metadata proves declared allocations and static spills, not actual occupancy, cache hits, memory bandwidth or MFMA utilization.
More/fewer refills or waits cannot establish their performance contribution without matched measurements.
Archive symbol names and matching opcode totals do not prove equivalence to the modern CO source generation.

first_round.rotation: Shared fixed count per shape and matched setting for current/reference/new candidates
gates: Implement only in an isolated experimental copy after authorization. Preserve current source/CO and14-case frozen bundle.
Before any GPU run, isolated CO metadata/ISA must preserve ABI, address bounds, two refill barriers, wait dependencies and pinned ranges; record resource deltas and reject unplanned scratch/spills.
Future correctness uses complete NaN-initialized BF16 output comparison, exact candidate IDs/names and error ratio<=.05.
Require stable matched-base gain across3 batches without a no-refill negative-control regression before expanding to R5/R6 or more171 shapes.
